name: World Boardgaming Championships
blurb: The Boardgame Players Association's annual tournament convention crowning champions across 160+ boardgames at Seven Springs Mountain Resort.

editions.evidence: wbcindex.html text: 'WBC 2027 will run from July 24 to August 1, 2027'; BPA homepage: 'Take a virtual tour of Seven Springs Mountain Resort.'

notes: Corrected the url from the given 'https://www.boardgamers.org/#wbc' (a dead fragment on the homepage) to the site's actual WBC page, wbcindex.html, reached via the homepage's 'wbcindex.html' link. Confirms the batch note: organizer is the Boardgame Players Association, and WBC replaced Avaloncon in 1999 (site text: the BPA's 'largest event is the annual World Boardgaming Championships® (WBC)'). This is a tournament/competition convention (160+ boardgame competitions, an auction, vendors) with no celebrity-guest or Guest-of-Honor program; the word 'guest' does not appear anywhere on the WBC or attending pages, so guests is 'none'. Site is a very old-style HTML site with no og/twitter image and no dedicated key art, so cover uses its plain masthead banner image (shared across its pages).
